name: cs-radio
description: Counter-Strike 1.6 radio calls for Claude Code: 'Fire in the hole' on deploys, 'Bomb has been defused' when a long turn lands. /radio to toggle.

soundDir.title: CS 1.6 radio folder
soundDir.description: Path to cstrike/sound/radio from your own Counter-Strike 1.6 install. Empty: look in the usual Steam folders, else speak the calls.

longTurnSeconds.title: Long turn (seconds)
longTurnSeconds.description: A turn at least this long plays 'Bomb has been defused' when it finishes.
